title: 3 skills worth learning before 2030

scenes.text: If I were starting my career today, knowing where India is headed by 2030 —
scenes.narration: If I were starting my career today, knowing where India is headed by twenty thirty, here's what I'd actually learn.

scenes.text: One. Applied AI — not just prompting, but plugging AI tools into a real workflow in your industry.
scenes.narration: One. Applied AI. Not just prompting, but plugging AI tools into a real workflow in your industry.

scenes.text: Two. Basic data literacy — reading a dashboard, spotting a trend, regardless of your field.
Three. Bilingual content fluency — English plus one Indian language, as India's internet audience crosses a billion.
None of these need a four-year degree.
